name: bellza-staging-only-replay-artifacts

artifacts.purpose: Represent the pre-incremental public schema used to reproduce Bellza staging in a disposable local clone.
artifacts.replayInstruction: Materialize as the first migration only inside a new disposable local Supabase clone, then apply the ordered incremental staging chain.
artifacts.immutability: Frozen bytes. Never edit in place; any replacement requires a new artifact, version, hash, review, and replay proof.

artifacts.purpose: Reproduce staging-only storage bucket metadata and policies without copying user objects or real customer data.
artifacts.replayInstruction: Materialize immediately after 20260919150000 and before 20260919152000, only inside the disposable local replay clone.
artifacts.immutability: Frozen bytes. Never edit in place; any replacement requires a new artifact, version, hash, review, and replay proof.

productionPolicy: Production migrations must never source, copy, or apply these staging-only artifacts. Production advances only through independently reviewed operational migrations against its existing verified ledger and schema.
